meta_description:
15K likes, 285 comments - tarasutaria on September 30, 2026: "Step into the festive season with @bobbibrownindia ‘s Luxe Lipstick - skincare-infused colour, a rich satin finish and 10Hr moisture for lips that feel as beautiful as they look.
Downtown Plum is my choice when I want to feel bold, while Hibiscus lets me play with colour and embrace a softer, more playful mood.
Whatever the celebration calls for, I’m Always in Luxe! 💄".
